svg.title: Egyptian Arabic Speech-to-Text: Speech recognition for Egyptian Arabic: Whisper large-v3 fine-tuned on real sales calls and served as an API.

g.text: Speech recognition for Egyptian Arabic: Whisper large-v3
fine-tuned on real sales calls and served as an API.
Fine-tuned Whisper large-v3 with LoRA; a data pipeline turns
call recordings and timestamped transcripts into training
segments, and the best model is chosen by word error rate
